set_seed: set the random seed for numpy, torch, and python random modules to a given integer value
config_logging: configure logging to dump messages to both console and a specified log file with custom formatting
cleanup_memory: run garbage collection and clear GPU memory cache across all available CUDA devices
get_logger: create and return a named logger with INFO level and a console handler using a standard format
get_global_rank: get the global process rank from torch distributed or the RANK environment variable
